title: Pin that the digest concept names every prose_load key
action: Contract C6 (decision 1ca9eddb). In the test module of packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/feedback.rs add one test whose name contains prose_load_doc_parity. It builds the prose_load object with prose_load_value on a fixture root (reuse the existing prose_load_fixture helper), collects every top-level key of that object, reads docs/knowledge/areas/feedback-digest/ranking-and-self-improvement.md from the repo root (find it the way other tests in the crate find repo files, for example env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR") joined up to the repo root), and asserts each key appears in the concept text. Show it red once by removing one key name from an in-memory copy of the text, then green. Quote the matched count. No code comments. Commit the test and that sentence together, then run .bee/bin/bee knowledge check.
